user_scope: Research/proof project; no real buying/selling. Broker and commissions are not forecast research prerequisites.

ohlc_audit.limit: Outside-range Close may be settlement/mark or mixed definitions, not necessarily bad forecast labels. No contract or bar-clock proof is inferred. Projection and filtered subsets are sensitivity diagnostics, not alternative prices or strategies.

rejected_reference_dates.reason: Printed reference date is #########; listing date alone not admitted

ams_reconciliation.limit: FUTURES TODAY quote correspondence is not a vendor settlement specification, certified contract map, executable price or historical availability proof. Quote-column transitions and adjacent-contract spreads are retrospective diagnostics only.

independent_verification.limit: Retrospective subset diagnostics, no new holdout/strategy/target or label repair. Contract name is independently quoted correspondence, not a certified Yahoo contract map.

official_sources.scope: Current specification: CT, 50000 lb, 0.01 cent tick, regular 21:00 New York opening; not an eight-year session or Yahoo mapping proof

command_scope: Existing local bytes only. No fits, dataset download, source repair, live artifact update, orders or new strategy selection.
